name: Nevo
description:
Remote **Model Context Protocol** server that exposes Nevo's legal-search and
document-fetch primitives as connector tools, so claude.ai, Claude Desktop, and
Claude Code can query Israeli verdicts, laws, and legal literature directly.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Nevo to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Nevo to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://stream.nevo.co.il/mcp/nevo. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Nevo MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Nevo provides these MCP tools: get_document_link, get_documents_full_text, init_session, and search_legal_context.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Nevo?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Nevo in search-research on the Manufact MCP catalog include Agentic Atlas: Agent Design Patterns, common-practice, GDELT Cloud, BookDNA, and Lyon.
Nevo requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Nevo is developed by Nevo ltd. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
